_why: MOD 1.1 AGAINST VANILLA 1.15.0, n=24 EACH, ALTERNATING 1:1 (vanilla first), 1836→1936. The user, 2026-11-08: "The lines will need a vanilla batch. We won't have a truly pure vanilla batch, rather alternating mod 1.1 vs vanilla 1.15.0, starting tonight (I'll give an explicit go-ahead), and finishing early next Sunday, 24 vs 24." It is GAME_UPDATE_1_15 U60 (the 1.15 vanilla reference, here this batch's 24 vanilla runs, which carry telemetry like every VANILLA_REF member) and U62 / Q12 (the canon re-measured against it) in one batch, after F268's n=1 + 1. The alternation puts any drift of the machine over the ~6.5 days on both arms alike (F248/F249), so the wall clock reads within the session. Its vanilla runs are the basis on which the user re-rules the register's absolute lines for 1.15 (the 10% pooled-U* hard line and capital abundance, which vanilla 1.15 itself broke in F268).
